input.answer: I can take it out tax-free 6 years after the first deposit. Before that they hold back a huge chunk for tax (47%). On the page's example salary, 5 years comes to about 50k ₪ landing in your account, maybe 66k if you wait. But I never saw one clear "this is what you get" number, so I'm only roughly sure.

stuck.why: Three numbers in one sentence and I couldn't tell which one is what I actually end up with. Almost 30k to tax looked terrifying.
